prefeito.comoAssumiu: Presidente da Câmara Municipal, assumiu a prefeitura de forma interina em 17/06/2026, em sessão solene da Câmara que declarou vagos os cargos de prefeito e vice, depois que a Justiça Eleitoral cassou a chapa eleita em 2024. Na eleição suplementar de 25/10/2026, foram eleitos Beto Leite (UNIÃO), prefeito, e Fernanda Crepaldi (UNIÃO), vice, com posse marcada para 26/11/2026.
prefeito.comoAssumiu_en: As president of the City Council, he became acting mayor on June 17, 2026, in a formal session of the City Council that declared the offices of mayor and vice mayor vacant, after the Electoral Courts revoked the ticket elected in 2024. In the special election held on October 25, 2026, Beto Leite (UNIÃO) was elected mayor and Fernanda Crepaldi (UNIÃO) vice mayor; their swearing-in is scheduled for November 26, 2026.

vice.txt: O cargo de vice-prefeito está vago desde 17/06/2026, quando a Câmara Municipal declarou vagos os cargos de prefeito e vice. Fernanda Crepaldi (UNIÃO), eleita vice-prefeita na eleição suplementar de 25/10/2026, toma posse em 26/11/2026.
vice.txt_en: The office of vice mayor has been vacant since June 17, 2026, when the City Council declared the offices of mayor and vice mayor vacant. Fernanda Crepaldi (UNIÃO), elected vice mayor in the special election held on October 25, 2026, takes office on November 26, 2026.
